name: Mestre/Fermigier Sextuple
description: Generic-rank-at-least-11 Mestre sextuple family with exact native quartic, sign-symmetry deduplication, native/PGL2 ratpoints search, rigorous-basis anchor recovery, reusable second-generation geometry-only fiber expansion, productivity-ranked chart promotion, persistent denominator-banded deep rational search, numerical novelty screening, and exact subgroup certification.
generic_rank_status: Published lower-bound family; eleven reconstructed sections are independently exact-certified by Rank Hunter at t=1.

provenance.author: Jean-François Mestre
provenance.paper: Courbes elliptiques de rang >= 11 sur Q(t)
provenance.journal: C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris Sér. I Math. 313 (1991), 139-142
provenance.claim_boundary: The plugin exposes eleven non-origin section points; numerical height screening and seed-curve chart geometry are not proofs. Specialization lower bounds are promoted only through the exact certificate path.
provenance.seed_search_policy: A stored high-rank Mestre specialization may contribute exact mapped native-quartic x-fibres as search geometry. When an exact rigorous elliptic generator matches persisted quartic provenance, the plugin reuses that exact native_x first and falls back to verified elliptic-to-quartic inversion. Ordinary hybrid same-fibre target search keeps subgroup anchors rigorous-only once certified non-base fibres exist. The separate Fiber Expansion strategy may additionally reuse previously mapped dependent/unclassified fibres as explicitly geometry-only anchors, ranked by recency and denominator novelty; those anchors never enter the Mordell-Weil basis and never transport rank evidence. Seeded neighbor searches remain bounded. Every rank change still requires the normal exact certificate path.
provenance.published_claim: Mestre proves a family over Q(t) of rank at least 11.
provenance.operational_certificate: Rank Hunter exact-certifies the eleven reconstructed sections at t=1 to verify generic lower bound 11.
provenance.reconstruction_boundary: The fixed sextuple and normalized quartic formulas are reconstruction data; the release does not claim every implementation coefficient is printed verbatim in the short paper.

search_presets.label: Scan
search_presets.description: Balanced screening profile for routine hunting.

search_presets.label: Widen
search_presets.description: Explore a substantially larger rational parameter box.

search_presets.label: Deep
search_presets.description: Deep family search plus a focused high-rank target profile. Banded rational search is enabled for any future H>=10^7 escalation while ordinary H<=10^6 work keeps its cached monolithic searches.

search_presets.label: Record Hunt
search_presets.description: High-end target profile: run all charts through the cheaper stages, promote the 16 most productive charts to H=10^7, and split deep rational work into persistent denominator bands with 20-second per-band heat caps.

search_presets.label: Fiber Expansion
search_presets.description: Second-generation target attack: preserve certified basis geometry, rank recent/high-denominator discovered fibres as geometry-only anchors, build mixed PGL2 charts, then promote charts by genuinely new fibre yield into banded H=10^7 search.

family.label: Search adapter
family.group_help: Choose the exact quartic/PGL2 coordinate attack and how many chart geometries to explore.
family.help: Native searches the family quartic directly. PGL2 searches exact coordinate transforms of the same quartic and enables chart-based strategies.

family.label: Seed curve ID
family.group_help: Advanced controls for structural, rigorous, seeded, and free-matrix anchors used to build PGL2 charts.
family.help: Optional stored Mestre curve whose exact native-fibre geometry is borrowed for a neighboring family search. Zero disables seeding.

family.label: ratpoints x mode
family.group_help: Choose the exact quartic/PGL2 coordinate attack and how many chart geometries to explore.
family.help: Integer searches denominator 1 only. Rational searches all allowed denominators. Both runs the cheap integer pass before nonintegral rational search.

family.label: PGL2 charts
family.group_help: Choose the exact quartic/PGL2 coordinate attack and how many chart geometries to explore.
family.help: Number of exact PGL2 coordinate charts searched per specialization. More charts increase geometric coverage and runtime.

family.label: Chart strategy
family.group_help: Choose the exact quartic/PGL2 coordinate attack and how many chart geometries to explore.
family.help: Base uses structural fibres, subgroup uses discovered non-base fibres, free uses small independent matrices, hybrid mixes them, and Fiber Expansion mixes certified anchors with geometry-only discoveries.

family.label: Certified/base anchor pool
family.group_help: Advanced controls for structural, rigorous, seeded, and free-matrix anchors used to build PGL2 charts.
family.help: Maximum structural or certified native-fibre anchors available when constructing chart transforms.

family.label: Rigorous discovered anchor pool
family.group_help: Advanced controls for structural, rigorous, seeded, and free-matrix anchors used to build PGL2 charts.
family.help: Maximum exact discovered non-base fibres available to rigorous/subgroup-informed chart planning.

family.label: Free PGL2 entry bound
family.group_help: Advanced controls for structural, rigorous, seeded, and free-matrix anchors used to build PGL2 charts.
family.help: Absolute coefficient bound for primitive integer free-PGL2 matrices. Larger values widen coordinate diversity but increase chart-planning cost.

family.label: Exploratory geometry pool
family.group_help: Geometry-only reuse of previously mapped fibres. These values affect coordinates and prioritization only; they never become rank evidence.
family.help: Maximum previously mapped geometry-only fibres used by Fiber Expansion. These anchors never enter the Mordell-Weil basis.

family.label: Exploratory ordering
family.group_help: Geometry-only reuse of previously mapped fibres. These values affect coordinates and prioritization only; they never become rank evidence.
family.help: How Fiber Expansion prioritizes geometry-only fibres: recent discoveries, large denominators, high rational height, or a combined recency/denominator score.

family.label: Exploratory chart mix
family.group_help: Geometry-only reuse of previously mapped fibres. These values affect coordinates and prioritization only; they never become rank evidence.
family.help: Controls the share of certified versus geometry-only anchors used in second-generation PGL2 charts.

family.label: ratpoints height stages
family.group_help: Controls how far ratpoints searches each chart and how long expensive rational passes are allowed to run.
family.help: Comma-separated numerator/denominator height bounds searched in increasing order. Completed stages are reused from the database.

family.label: Seconds per stage
family.group_help: Controls how far ratpoints searches each chart and how long expensive rational passes are allowed to run.
family.help: Hard runtime budget for one ratpoints chart/pass/stage before Rank Hunter stops it and moves on.

family.label: Rational stage cap (s)
family.group_help: Controls how far ratpoints searches each chart and how long expensive rational passes are allowed to run.
family.help: Optional stricter runtime cap for rational/nonintegral stages. Zero uses the normal seconds-per-stage budget.

family.label: Rational timeout circuit
family.group_help: Controls how far ratpoints searches each chart and how long expensive rational passes are allowed to run.
family.help: After this many timeouts in the same deep denominator band, that band is skipped on remaining charts. Zero disables the circuit breaker.

family.label: Banded rational search
family.group_help: Splits very large rational searches into resumable denominator bands and optionally promotes only productive charts to the deepest height.
family.help: Split large rational denominator ranges into persistent bands so completed regions can be resumed instead of repeated.

family.group_help: Splits very large rational searches into resumable denominator bands and optionally promotes only productive charts to the deepest height.
family.help: Minimum ratpoints height at which rational search is split into denominator bands.

family.label: Denominator band ceilings
family.group_help: Splits very large rational searches into resumable denominator bands and optionally promotes only productive charts to the deepest height.
family.help: Ascending denominator ceilings used when banding is active. max means the current stage height.

family.label: Promote charts at height ≥
family.group_help: Splits very large rational searches into resumable denominator bands and optionally promotes only productive charts to the deepest height.
family.help: Rational stages at or above this height are deferred until charts are ranked by genuinely new-fibre yield. Zero disables promotion.
